description: Edit a skill you own (each field passed REPLACES that field whole, and get_skill returns the current text; editing someone else's skill is refused). Pass `visibility` to move it between `personal`, `members` (only the people in `members`; that list REPLACES the whole set), `shared` (the whole workspace) and `public` (only raises an approval a person must give in the app Inbox). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES update_skill"]

instructions.description: Replaces the whole procedure (get_skill returns the current one).

members.description: With visibility `members`: who can see it, as user ids from list_members or exact names. On update this REPLACES the whole set, so adding or removing someone means sending the full new list (get_skill returns the current one). Everyone not named gets nothing, not even a hint the skill exists.

version.description: Semver, e.g. "1.1.0". Bump it when you change the procedure.

visibility.description: Who can see it: `shared` (the whole workspace; the default), `personal` (only the token owner), `members` (only the people in `members`, plus you), or `public` (anyone with a link). `public` is NOT applied by this call: it raises an approval that a PERSON must give in the app Inbox; until then the skill stays as it was.

name: update_skill
title: Update skill
